legend: Initially there was an array a$$$a$$$ consisting of n$$$n$$$ integers. Positions in it are numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$.

Exactly q$$$q$$$ queries were performed on the array. During the i$$$i$$$-th query some segment (li,ri)$$$(l_i, r_i)$$$ (1≤li≤ri≤n)$$$(1 \le l_i \le r_i \le n)$$$ was selected and values of elements on positions from li$$$l_i$$$ to ri$$$r_i$$$ inclusive got changed to i$$$i$$$. The order of the queries couldn't be changed and all q$$$q$$$ queries were applied. It is also known that every position from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$ got covered by at least one segment.

We could have offered you the problem about checking if some given array (consisting of n$$$n$$$ integers with values from 1$$$1$$$ to q$$$q$$$) can be obtained by the aforementioned queries. However, we decided that it will come too easy for you.
So the enhancement we introduced to it is the following. Some set of positions (possibly empty) in this array is selected and values of elements on these positions are set to 0$$$0$$$.
Your task is to check if this array can be obtained by the aforementioned queries. Also if it can be obtained then restore this array.
If there are multiple possible arrays then print any of them.
input: The first line contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and q$$$q$$$ (1≤n,q≤2⋅105$$$1 \le n, q \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of elements of the array and the number of queries perfomed on it.

The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integer numbers a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ (0≤ai≤q$$$0 \le a_i \le q$$$) — the resulting array. If element at some position j$$$j$$$ is equal to 0$$$0$$$ then the value of element at this position can be any integer from 1$$$1$$$ to q$$$q$$$.
output: Print "YES" if the array a$$$a$$$ can be obtained by performing q$$$q$$$ queries. Segments (li,ri)$$$(l_i, r_i)$$$ (1≤li≤ri≤n)$$$(1 \le l_i \le r_i \le n)$$$ are chosen separately for each query. Every position from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$ should be covered by at least one segment.

If some array can be obtained then print n$$$n$$$ integers on the second line — the i$$$i$$$-th number should be equal to the i$$$i$$$-th element of the resulting array and should have value from 1$$$1$$$ to q$$$q$$$. This array should be obtainable by performing exactly q$$$q$$$ queries.
If there are multiple possible arrays then print any of them.
note: In the first example you can also replace 0$$$0$$$ with 1$$$1$$$ but not with 3$$$3$$$.
In the second example it doesn't really matter what segments to choose until query 10$$$10$$$ when the segment is (1,3)$$$(1, 3)$$$.

The third example showcases the fact that the order of queries can't be changed, you can't firstly set (1,3)$$$(1, 3)$$$ to 6$$$6$$$ and after that change (2,2)$$$(2, 2)$$$ to 5$$$5$$$. The segment of 5$$$5$$$ should be applied before segment of 6$$$6$$$.
There is a lot of correct resulting arrays for the fourth example.

legend.ai: 最初有一个数组 a$$$a$$$，其中包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数。数组中的位置编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$。

在该数组上进行了恰好 q$$$q$$$ 次查询。在第 i$$$i$$$ 次查询中，选择了某个区间 (li,ri)$$$(l_i, r_i)$$$(1≤li≤ri≤n)$$$(1 \le l_i \le r_i \le n)$$$，并将位置从 li$$$l_i$$$ 到 ri$$$r_i$$$(包含两端)上的元素值修改为 i$$$i$$$。查询的顺序无法改变，并且全部 q$$$q$$$ 次查询都会执行。另知从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$ 的每个位置都至少被某个区间覆盖了一次。
我们本可以给你这样一道题：判断给定数组(由 n$$$n$$$ 个整数构成，元素值在 1$$$1$$$ 到 q$$$q$$$ 之间)是否能够通过上述查询得到。然而，我们认为这对你来说过于简单了。
因此，我们对其进行了如下增强。在这个数组中选择一个位置集合(可能为空)，并将这些位置上的元素值设为 0$$$0$$$。
你的任务是判断这个数组是否能够通过上述查询得到。如果可以，还需要还原这个数组。
如果有多个可能的数组，输出其中任意一个即可。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 q$$$q$$$(1≤n,q≤2⋅105$$$1 \le n, q \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)，分别表示数组中元素的数量以及对其执行的查询次数。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$(0≤ai≤q$$$0 \le a_i \le q$$$)，表示最终得到的数组。如果某个位置 j$$$j$$$ 上的元素等于 0$$$0$$$，那么该位置上的元素可以是从 1$$$1$$$ 到 q$$$q$$$ 的任意整数。

output.ai: 如果数组 a$$$a$$$ 可以通过执行 q$$$q$$$ 次查询得到，则输出“YES”。对于每次查询，需要分别选择一个区间 (li,ri)$$$(l_i, r_i)$$$(1≤li≤ri≤n$$$(1 \le l_i \le r_i \le n)$$$)。从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$ 的每个位置都至少应被一个区间覆盖。
如果存在某个数组可以被得到，则在第二行输出 n$$$n$$$ 个整数，第 i$$$i$$$ 个数应等于最终数组中的第 i$$$i$$$ 个元素，且其值应在 1$$$1$$$ 到 q$$$q$$$ 之间。该数组应当可以通过恰好执行 q$$$q$$$ 次查询得到。
如果有多个可能的数组，输出其中任意一个即可。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，你也可以将 0$$$0$$$ 替换为 1$$$1$$$，但不能替换为 3$$$3$$$。
在第二个样例中，在查询 10$$$10$$$ 之前选择哪些区间其实并不重要，此时区间为 (1,3)$$$(1, 3)$$$。
第三个样例体现了查询顺序无法改变这一事实：你不能先将 (1,3)$$$(1, 3)$$$ 设置为 6$$$6$$$，然后再将 (2,2)$$$(2, 2)$$$ 修改为 5$$$5$$$。应当先应用 5$$$5$$$ 所对应的区间，再应用 6$$$6$$$ 所对应的区间。
对于第四个样例，正确的结果数组有很多种。
